The sheets are raster only (no vector paths; embedded JPEG drawings 1934x886 / 1936x884 px), so the width is measured on the raster, centre of edge line to centre of edge line, along the row direction in the top view. HTM461-6 top view: scale from 4 printed dimensions on that view, .720 = 291 px (404.2 px/in), .895 = 362 px (404.5), .460 = 186 px (404.3), .421 = 170.5 px (405.0), spread 0.2 %; pin centres 195/252/308 px agree with .280 (113 px, 403.6 px/in) and are evenly spaced. All 6 tabs measure 12 px (12.5 on one) = 0.0297 in. HTM601-6 top view: the image is anisotropic (x 282.3/282.5 px/in from .937 and 1.124; y 288.3/289.3 from .600 and .413), so the vertical (y) scale is used: tab 8.5 px = 0.0294 in. Edge-line precision is +-1 px = +-0.0025 in, so the value is rounded to the nearest 0.005 in, NOT 0.001: 0.030 in. HTM460/600/850 have no individual sheet; the series sheet draws one generic terminal for all six HTM sizes (same .280, .281, .080), and the two measured sheets agree, so one value serves all three.
